29612-treatise-on-the-diseases-of-women.title: Treatise On The Diseases Of Women
29612-treatise-on-the-diseases-of-women.creator: Unknown
29612-treatise-on-the-diseases-of-women.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. =Personal Experience Necessary.=--After you have once suffered, how ready you are to sympathize with those who are going through the same severe trials. If a member of your own home or a friend is passing through the trying ordeal of motherhood, and you have suffered the same, how you can advise, suggest, comfort, guide!

arxiv-2102-02310.title: Epoch of reionization parameter estimation with the 21-cm bispectrum 2026
arxiv-2102-02310.creator: Catherine A. Watkinson, Bradley Greig, Andrei Mesinger
arxiv-2102-02310.description: Abstract We present the first application of the isosceles bispectrum to MCMC parameter inference from the cosmic 21-cm signal. We extend the MCMC sampler 21cmmc to use the fast bispectrum code, BiFFT , when computing the likelihood. We create mock 1000h observations with SKA1-low, using pyObs21 to account for uv-sampling and thermal noise.

arxiv-2111-07814.title: Spatial-Interference Aware Cooperative Resource Allocation for 5G NR Sidelink Communications
arxiv-2111-07814.creator: E-mails: {silvia.mura, francesco.linsalata, marouan.mizmizi}@polimi.it
arxiv-2111-07814.description: Abstract Distributed resource allocation (RA) schemes have been introduced in cellular vehicle-to-everything (C-V2X) standard for vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) sidelink (SL) communications to share the limited spectrum (sub-6GHz) efficiently. However, the recent progress in connected and automated vehicles and mobility services requires a huge amount of available spectrum resources.

arxiv-2211-02050.title: Adaptive Batch Normalization for Training Data with Heterogeneous Features
arxiv-2211-02050.creator: Wael Alsobhi 1, 4 , Tarik Alafif 1, 5 , Weiwei Zong 2, 6 and Alaa E. Abdel-Hakim 1, 3, 7
arxiv-2211-02050.description: Abstract Batch Normalization (BN) is an important preprocessing step to many deep learning applications. Since it is a data-dependent process, for some homogeneous datasets it is a redundant or even a performance-degrading process. In this paper, we propose an early-stage feasibility assessment method for estimating the benefits of applying BN on the given data batches.

arxiv-2310-13962.title: Character of electronic states in the transport gap of molecules on surfaces
arxiv-2310-13962.creator: Abhishek Grewal, Christopher C. Leon, Klaus Kuhnke, Klaus Kern, Olle Gunnarsson
arxiv-2310-13962.description: Abstract We report on scanning tunneling microscopy (STM) topographs of individual metal phthalocyanines (MPc) on a thin salt (NaCl) film on a gold substrate, at tunneling energies within the molecule’s electronic transport gap. Theoretical models of increasing complexity are discussed.

arxiv-2401-15305.title: A Practical Probabilistic Benchmark for AI Weather Models
arxiv-2401-15305.creator: Noah D. Brenowitz, Yair Cohen, Jaideep Pathak, Ankur Mahesh, Boris Bonev, Thorsten Kurth, Dale R. Durran, Peter Harrington, Michael S. Pritchard
arxiv-2401-15305.description: Abstract Key Points • Lagged ensembling is a practical, quantitative, and parameter-free framework for benchmarking weather models • Lagged ensembles of some recent data-driven forecasts are under-dispersive despite claims of “state of the art” deterministic skill • Training data-driven models with multi-step loss functions damages ensemble calibration Abstract Since the weather is chaotic, it is necessary to forecast an ensemble

arxiv-2402-12310.title: Cosmic dust fertilization of glacial prebiotic chemistry on early Earth
arxiv-2402-12310.creator: Craig R. Walton 1 , 2 ∗ {}^{1,2}*, Jessica K. Rigley 1 ∗ {}^{1}*, Alex Lipp 3, Robert Law 4, Martin D. Suttle 5, Maria Schönbächler 2, Mark Wyatt 1, Oliver Shorttle 1,6
arxiv-2402-12310.description: Abstract Earth’s surface is deficient in available forms of many elements considered limiting for prebiotic chemistry. In contrast, many extraterrestrial rocky objects are rich in these same elements. Limiting prebiotic ingredients may therefore have been delivered by exogenous material; however, the mechanisms by which exogeneous material may be reliably and non-destructively supplied to a planetary surface remains unclear.

arxiv-2403-12650.title: Adaptive Multilevel Neural Networks for Parametric PDEs with Error Estimation
arxiv-2403-12650.creator: Janina E. Schütte, Martin Eigel
arxiv-2403-12650.description: Abstract To solve high-dimensional parameter-dependent partial differential equations (pPDEs), a neural network architecture is presented. It is constructed to map parameters of the model data to corresponding finite element solutions. To improve training efficiency and to enable control of the approximation error, the network mimics an adaptive finite element method (AFEM).

arxiv-2410-16579.title: Conflict-Aware Adversarial Training
arxiv-2410-16579.creator: Zhiyu Xue, Haohan Wang, Yao Qin, Ramtin Pedarsani
arxiv-2410-16579.description: Abstract Adversarial training is the most effective method to obtain adversarial robustness for deep neural networks by directly involving adversarial samples in the training procedure. To obtain an accurate and robust model, the weighted-average method is applied to optimize standard loss and adversarial loss simultaneously.

arxiv-2411-00151.title: NIMBA : Towards Robust and Principled Processing of Point Clouds With SSMs
arxiv-2411-00151.creator: Nursena Köprücü, Destiny Okpekpe, Antonio Orvieto
arxiv-2411-00151.description: Abstract Transformers have become dominant in large-scale deep learning tasks across various domains, including text, 2D and 3D vision. However, the quadratic complexity of their attention mechanism limits their efficiency as the sequence length increases, particularly in high-resolution 3D data such as point clouds.

arxiv-2502-01250.title: Beyond Win Rates: A Clustering-Based Approach to Character Balance Analysis in Team-Based Games
arxiv-2502-01250.creator: Haokun Zhou
arxiv-2502-01250.description: Abstract Character diversity in competitive games, while enriching gameplay, often introduces balance challenges that can negatively impact player experience and strategic depth. Traditional balance assessments rely on aggregate metrics like win rates and pick rates, which offer limited insight into the intricate dynamics of team-based games and nuanced character roles.

arxiv-2508-06392.title: FVGen: Accelerating Novel-View Synthesis with Adversarial Video Diffusion Distillation
arxiv-2508-06392.creator: Wenbin Teng, Gonglin Chen, Haiwei Chen, Yajie Zhao
arxiv-2508-06392.description: Abstract Recent progress in 3D reconstruction has enabled realistic 3D models from dense image captures, yet challenges persist with sparse views, often leading to artifacts in unseen areas. Recent works leverage Video Diffusion Models (VDMs) to generate dense observations, filling the gaps when only sparse views are available for 3D reconstruction tasks.

arxiv-2509-17610.title: Towards the State Space Interpretation (SSI): A Formalized Framework for Game Studies and Design
arxiv-2509-17610.creator: Zhenghao Wang, Shuo Xiong
arxiv-2509-17610.description: Abstract In this paper, we establish structural analogies between core concepts in quantum mechanics and games. By constructing the Quantum Coin Toss on a quantum circuit, we preliminarily investigate the similarity between quantum system behavior and game behavior, thereby formulating the state-operation paradigm. Using this paradigm, we introduce the conceptual prototype of the State Space Interpretation (SSI).

arxiv-2512-01767.title: Non-integrability of the Sasano system of type A 5 ( 2 ) A_{5}^{(2)}
arxiv-2512-01767.creator: Tsvetana Stoyanova
arxiv-2512-01767.description: Abstract . The Sasano system of type A 5 ( 2 ) A^{(2)}_{5} is a four-dimensional non-linear system of ordinary differential equations, which has an affine Weyl group of symmetries of type A 5 ( 2 ) A^{(2)}_{5} . It is also a time dependent Hamiltonian system, which can be considered as coupled Painlevé III systems.

pmc-10624074.title: Associations of Estradiol With Mortality and Health Outcomes in Patients Undergoing Hemodialysis: A Prospective Cohort Study
pmc-10624074.creator: Lina Lau, Natasha Wiebe, Sharanya Ramesh, Sofia Ahmed, Scott Klarenbach, Juan-Jesus Carrero, Peter Stenvinkel, Barbara Thorand, Peter Senior, Marcello Tonelli, Aminu K Bello
pmc-10624074.description: Background:Both lower and higher estradiol (E2) levels have been associated with increased mortality among women with kidney failure. However, robust data are still lacking.Objective:We investigated the interaction of diabetes and age on linear and nonlinear associations between E2 levels, adverse outcomes, and health-related quality of life (HRQOL) in Canadian women undergoing hemodialysis (HD).

pmc-11371553.title: Correlation between the gut microbiota characteristics of hosts with severe acute pancreatitis and secondary intra-abdominal infection
pmc-11371553.creator: Lihui Wang, Weijun Zhang, Simin Dai, Yuan Gao, Cheng Zhu, Yuetian Yu
pmc-11371553.description: ObjectiveThe objective of the study is to investigate the changes in the composition of intestinal microecology in severe acute pancreatitis (SAP) patients with or without intra-abdominal infection and also to analyze the expression of antibiotic resistance genes to provide evidence for early warning of infectious diseases and the rational use of antibiotics.MethodsTwenty patients with SAP were enrolled in the study.

pmc-12595738.title: Sexually dimorphic responses in androgen metabolism and signalling in the non-human primate placenta to moderate maternal undernutrition
pmc-12595738.creator: Ashley S Meakin, Peter W Nathanielsz, Cun Li, Vicki L Clifton, Hillary F Huber, Michael D Wiese, Janna L Morrison
pmc-12595738.description: BackgroundMaternal nutrient restriction (MNR) can increase maternal androgen concentrations during pregnancy and cause placental dysfunction leading to reduced fetal growth, especially in males. Placental androgen metabolism, as well as differential expression and subcellular localisation of androgen receptor (AR) variants, modulates androgen signalling, which may benefit placental function; however, the impact of MNR on these adaptations remains undefined.

pmc-13173120.title: 112 Prevalence of hearing loss and hearing aid use among US older adults: Health and retirement study
pmc-13173120.creator: Janet Choi, Jung Ki Kim, Eileen Crimmins
pmc-13173120.description: Objectives/Goals: Emerging studies demonstrate association of hearing loss with adverse mental and cognitive outcomes, warranting the need for reliable measures of hearing in epidemiological research. This study compared the prevalence of hearing loss among US adults based on objective and self-reported measures, as well as hearing aid use from the HRS.

pmc-13222619.title: A Thermosensitive Hydrogel Embedded with Metronidazole-Derived Carbon Dots for Antibacterial Treatment of Periodontitis
pmc-13222619.creator: Dingjie Wang, Xingrong Feng, Xiaoyi Tang, Yuntong Hu, Xiaodong Xing, Yuhong Xiao
pmc-13222619.description: IntroductionMicroorganisms are the primary initiators of periodontitis, and local antibiotic therapy remains an important adjunctive strategy for controlling periodontal pathogenic bacteria. However, conventional antimicrobial agents often exhibit limited local retention and may induce cytotoxicity or bacterial resistance. This study aimed to develop a thermosensitive hydrogel system incorporating metronidazole-derived carbon dots (Met-CDs) for localized antibacterial treatment of periodontitis.

pmc-13396798.title: Genetic architecture of white matter microstructure captured by unsupervised deep representation learning of fractional anisotropy maps
pmc-13396798.creator: Xingzhong Zhao, Ziqian Xie, Wei He, Hyun Yong Koh, Bohong Guo, Han Chen, Myriam Fornage, Degui Zhi
pmc-13396798.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Fractional anisotropy (FA) from diffusion MRI is a widely used marker of white matter (WM) integrity, but conventional FA-based genetic studies typically rely on tract- or atlas-defined averages that may obscure spatially distributed WM variation and limit genetic discovery. Here, we propose a deep learning framework, termed unsupervised deep representation of WM (UDR-WM), which uses voxel-wise FA maps to derive brain-wide unsupervised deep imaging phenotypes (UDIP-FA) without prior anatomical assumptions.

pmc-13615550.title: Acute and Chronic Effects of Green Tea Kombucha With and Without Grape Skin Extract on Immune and Oxidative Stress Markers in Beginner Runners: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-13615550.creator: Dandara Baia Bonifácio, Rayanne Santos de Paulo, Pedro Henrique Viana Mendes, Udielle Vermelho Lacerda, Rodrigo Rezende Cardoso, Helton de Sá Souza, Frederico Augusto Ribeiro de Barros, Josefina Bressan
pmc-13615550.description: Green tea kombucha is an antioxidant‐rich beverage with promising health benefits. However, evidence regarding its effects in physically active individuals remains limited. This study investigated the acute and chronic effects of green tea kombucha, with or without grape skin extract, on immune and oxidative stress markers in beginner runners.
